args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A few notes on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb, so the two names refer to the same account.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That report should be updated to the Pellow Home Living name.
- Please check whether any other saved reports or digests still use the Covey & Lark label, so the old name doesn't cause more confusion.
- For the mixed-up rows: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Sofia Marchetti (drafted with assistant)
